entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
Petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Rudrapur P.S. Case No. 102 of 2022 registered for the offence under section 420, 376/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has not committed any offence as alleged in the first information report and he has been falsely implicated in this case due to village politics.
In medical examination, no evidence of sexual assault was found.
Learned Adll. P.P. appearing for the State opposes the prayer for bail and submits that petitioner is named accused Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.56575 of 2022(5) dt.20-04-2023 and there is direct allegation against him.
The victim in her statement under section 164 Cr.P.C. has stated that the petitioner made sexual relation with her and later on declined to solemnize marriage with her.
The petitioner, therefore, does not deserve to be granted the privilege of anticipatory bail.
